summary: scripts/st-test no longer signs a crate's rust-tests note when one of the crate's tests passed only on a retry, matching CI's own per-crate notes (scripts/ci-rust-test-notes); the crate stays uncovered and CI runs it. linux-gate's whole-tree note still signs and records those tests as the input flaky_tests

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes; flaky_tests is one more free-form input, like env_skips.

rules.detail: A local run whose nextest report shows a retried pass signs fewer crates: those crates are left for CI. st-test exits 4 (nothing failed, a check not signed) instead of 0 for such a run.

compatibility.detail: Existing notes are unchanged and still verify; a note without flaky_tests is read as before.

recovery.detail: Revert the change to scripts/st-test; notes already signed are unaffected.
